title: Terms and Conditions of Electric Service: Stopping Service, Final Bills and Credit Refunds
content:
These terms of the **Electric Service Agreement** set out how an agreement with Lakeshore Power & Light Company is stopped, cancelled or closed, and how a closed agreement is final-billed and refunded.

**1. Who may stop service.** Only the customer of record can stop service or cancel a start. The company's agent records the request as a stop-service order or a cancel-start order awaiting the customer's confirmation, and the agreement closes only when the customer confirms.

**2. Stop effective date.** The stop effective date must be at least the schedule's minimum stop notice in business days after the request date, counting business days as Monday through Friday excluding company holidays; an earlier date is moved to the first permitted date. A date exactly that many business days after the request date is permitted; one business day earlier is moved. Hypothetical illustration with a minimum of two business days and no holiday: for a Thursday request, Friday is business day one and Monday business day two, so a Friday date moves to Monday and a Monday or later date stands.

**3. Cancelling a start.** A start can be cancelled only while the agreement is pending start; once it is active, cancellation of the start is no longer available.

**4. Closure of a disconnected agreement.** A disconnected agreement not reconnected within the schedule's disconnected-closure period, in calendar days after the disconnection date, is closed by the system on the day after that period ends. Hypothetically, with disconnection on 1 May and a period of 30 days, the period ends on 31 May and the agreement closes on 1 June unless it was reconnected by 31 May.

**5. Final bill.** Every closure issues a final bill within the schedule's final bill issue period in business days.

**6. Deposit and refund.** Any security deposit held is applied to the final bill under the Security Deposit program before a refund is considered. A credit balance remaining on a closed agreement after the final bill and deposit application is refunded by check when it is at least the schedule's credit refund minimum. A refund is issued only on a closed agreement whose balance is below zero, and only for the whole credit balance; no partial refund is made, and an agreement that is not closed receives no refund.
